fee_notes: Royalty is 5% of Net Sales, due 20th of each month. Advertising and Marketing Fee is currently 4% of Net Sales for traditional Restaurants and 2% for non-traditional Restaurants (maximums of 4.25% and 2.25% respectively during Initial Term). Financial Reporting System Fee currently none, capped at $15/month when implemented. Online Learning Management System License Fee currently $240 annually. ADA Extension Fee is 4.5% of monthly average system-wide sales if Development Schedule not met (up to 13 months).
